title: A Letter for the Harbor
author: Ansel Joubert
blurb: Gideon Dravenmoor, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
